answer: One honest agent books one witness; a farm books a hundred, and the mirror is a calendar full of appointments while the garden stays the same flat reward. A human witness must vouch for every name: that is what Ordained bailiff licence with bailiffs endorsement demands, since a licence bailiffs renew after warrant audits. A witness costs 14 days of queue time per proof, which no amount of spending can shorten per appearance, and the wander is that the witness has to turn up for each clone separately.
